ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.82:0.18 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) contiguous regions occupy the central and lateral fields of both lobes. Low-intensity (black) pigmentation is localized to the entire perimeter of the trailing edge, the distal tips, and a broad central vertical band at the peduncle junction. Dark radial striations extend from the center into the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth extending roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration characterized by multiple jagged peaks and U-shaped indentations (pixel amplitude 5-15) along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge segments follow a broadly concave trajectory from the notch to the distal tips, while the tips themselves exhibit a sharp convex recurve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular low-contrast pixel clusters (3-10 pixels in diameter) consistent with barnacle attachment scars are detected in high density near the distal tips and lower margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear streaks detected; three prominent diagonal marks on the inner-left lobe and one vertical linear disruption on the lower-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of deep, irregular indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe suggesting past physical trauma. Widespread circular pigmentation voids distributed across both white lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dendritic or 'flame-like' pigmentation pattern at the base of the median notch, where black pixels branch into the white fields.
